## Checklist

- [ ] `NEWS.md` has a bullet under the next version that says what the code
      does now.
- [ ] Tests cover the change and `devtools::test()` passes.
- [ ] `devtools::document()` has been run and `man/` and `NAMESPACE` are
      committed.
- [ ] `styler::style_pkg(indent_by = 4)` changes nothing.
- [ ] `spelling::spell_check_package()` finds no new word.
- [ ] Results are unchanged, or the pull request says which results change
      and why (and the golden fixture is regenerated).
